newsitem.title: FRANCE: Total leads French oil stock rally.
newsitem.headline: Total leads French oil stock rally.

text.p: French oil shares rose sharply for a second day on Thursday as analysts raised their estimates of the reserves of an Angolan oilfield in which Total is part-owner, traders said.

Its shares rose 2.95 percent on top of Wednesday's 4.43 percent rise. Total holds 20 percent of the block 14 field in Angola. Chevron, the operator of the field and owner of 31 percent, has said the reserves are huge.
Elf shares, which rose 2.04 percent on Wednesday, added a further 1.5 percent to trade at 609 francs at 1125 GMT.
The rise was well above that of the blue-chip index, which was flat after a surge to a historic high on Wednesday.
Traders said it is bolstered by a perception that it has underperformed Total. They said its stock is well oriented after breaching the 602 franc level.
One trader said Total's gains were also fuelled by a rumour of a gas find in Asia.
